title: Stop Foreign Funds in Elections Act
latestAction: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration.
summary:
Stop Foreign Funds in Elections Act

This bill prohibits contributions or donations by foreign nationals in connection with state or local ballot initiatives, referenda, or recall elections.
